mapper.select: SELECT FROM repair_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.user_id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM repair_members WHERE user_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM repair_members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_members SET role=#{role},status=#{status},version=version+1,auth_version=auth_version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE repair_members SET display_name=#{displayName},contact_phone=#{contactPhone},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM repair_stores s JOIN repair_member_stores ms ON ms.store_id=s.id AND ms.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id DESC
SELECT * FROM repair_stores WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_stores SET code=#{code},name=#{name},region=#{region},address=#{address},status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
